title: Accessibility
fontSizeGuide: Choose the reading size that feels most comfortable. This setting applies across the app.
appGoal: This app is designed to meet
appGoalSuffix: and related accessibility expectations across supported regions.
contactDesc: If you find an accessibility issue or need help, contact us through the channel below. We respond within 3 business days.
highContrastDesc: Increase contrast between text and background for easier reading.
complianceSummary: Core screens support readable text, screen readers, larger touch targets, and consistent navigation.
legalSummary: The current experience is aligned with WCAG 2.1 AA and related rules such as ADA / Section 508 and EAA 2025.
statusBody: Most screens already meet WCAG 2.1 AA. Remaining legacy screens are being updated, and reported issues are prioritized.
